rules.name: asks the app to toggle when the dock toggle is clicked
rules.note: The dock does not change its own placement: the app passes the next placement (side and rail on a wide screen, sheet and peek on a narrow one), whose markup the fixtures show. The same holds for the expand and collapse button of the sheet and the peek.

rules.name: grows the sheet to its tall height on ArrowUp on the handle
rules.note: ArrowDown goes back to var(--layout-sheet-height). Both keys are always prevented on the handle, even when the height is already at that end.

rules.name: switches between the two heights on a keyboard click of the handle
rules.note: A pointer click switches too, unless it ends a drag that moved 12px or more.

rules.name: follows a drag of the handle with the height in px
rules.source: Dock.svelte and dock-sheet.svelte.ts (DockSheet), dock.ts (press, follow, dockSheetHeight)
rules.note: While dragging, the height is the panel's height at the press less the travel, written in px and clamped between 0 and the tall height, and the panel has is-dragging, which turns its height transition off. The two .dock-probe elements measure the token heights. The handle sits at the top of the drawer, which grows upward from the bottom of the dock, so the dock needs the panel's height of room above it.

rules.name: settles at the nearest height when the drag of the handle ends
rules.note: On release after moving at least 12px the sheet settles at the nearest of closed, standard and tall, or, after a flick, at the next one in the flick direction; settling at closed calls ontoggle and leaves the standard height for the next opening. From the standard height (40dvh), a drag up by 200px ends nearest the tall height (75dvh), and a flick up ends there too, on any page from 440px to 1140px tall. The click that ends a drag of 12px or more does not switch the height.
